locations.label: Exo Suit station
locations.description: Open routes through Administration, Holding, Morgue and Exo Testing. Use the local power generators to activate equipment as you reach it. Collect your Exo Suit from the station in Exo Testing; a suit and the Exo Slam upgrade are separate requirements. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Black Box terminal
locations.description: Carry it to the computer on the right side of the Morgue and interact to install it. Wait for Angie’s acknowledgement before beginning the four card puzzles. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Warbird Black Box
locations.description: Collect the Black Box lying to the left of the crashed Warbird in spawn. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Four infection keypads
locations.description: During an infected round, become infected in Administration. Use all four keypads during the same infection; their order is unrestricted. Cleansing before all four are used clears this attempt. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Oz cell-card puzzle
locations.description: In Holding, shoot the metal bar beneath the middle cell until it disappears. Its reaction to shots identifies the correct bar. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Decontamination shower
locations.description: Locate the decontamination shower before an infected round and keep a route to Administration’s four keypads open. Use the 3D Printer for the EM1 and weapon stations for upgrades; the quest later unlocks the experimental Mk 25 station. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.

locations.label: Experimental Mk 25 upgrade
locations.description: Return to spawn to see the extraction scene. The standard route allows continued play and unlocks the experimental Exo Testing upgrade station for Mk 20 → Mk 25. The qualifying alternate route ends the match. Region-level overlay only: consult the guide photographs for the exact object and current match conditions.
